title: Verify unique hourly coverage and honest sequence measurements
objective: Verify unique hourly coverage and honest sequence measurements. Preserve existing owner semantics and historical evidence.

evidence.summary: Independent findings and corrected external-audit claims.
Read-only probes with synthetic temporary fixtures; no paid API calls.

reproduction: Stub fetch_klines with 168 synthetic rows for 2026-W35, replace hour 50 with hour 49, then run final mode at 2026-08-31T00:05Z: the package reports COMPLETE/PASS despite only 167 unique hours. Independently inspect first-hour open fallback and noncontiguous previous_close in build_hourly_sequence, and the passed/planned owner denominator in build_capture_index.

positive: Final completeness requires the exact unique contiguous UTC hourly grid for the requested window, with valid closed candle boundaries.
Hourly returns use comparable adjacent observations; a missing predecessor or a gap is explicit missing evidence.
Passed/planned owner counts use the same owner-role population and preserve separate registered-source information.
negative: Duplicate, missing, out-of-window, misaligned or conflicting candles cannot receive COMPLETE solely from row count.
Do not interpolate hours, reinterpret an open-to-close return as close-to-close, rewrite historical captures or add external calls.
